metric: reward, the unweighted mean over the four groups of a log-band map of each group's mean VRMSE (score.py)

lower.what: persistence: repeat the last context frame for every step
lower.rationale: a real predictor rather than a degenerate one. Zero prediction scores lower (0.2202) but is not a baseline any submission would fall below by accident.

upper.what: per-group oracle: the best VRMSE any measured model reached on each group
upper.caveat: this routes each group to a different model, which environment/contract.md forbids for a submission. The best legal single package measured is 0.3446, which normalises to 0.450. A joint-pool fine-tune was trained specifically to replace this bound with a legal package and came out below the floor (docs/validation/pdet_finetune_joint.json), so the gap is a research gap rather than an unrun baseline.

note: the raw reward has almost no dynamic range: a package that predicts nothing scores 0.2202 and the best legal package 0.3446, so the whole meaningful band is 0.12 wide. The normalised score is what should be compared across tracks; reward.txt keeps the raw value.
